parameters.name: before_id

AbsenceChange.title: AbsenceChange
AbsenceChange.description: Changes one absence (``id`` given) or adds one (no ``id``). ``delete`` removes an existing one.

Allocation.title: Allocation
Allocation.description: Response: an employee or (once the subcontractor feature exists) external allocation.

AllocationChange.title: AllocationChange
AllocationChange.description: What-if change of an employee allocation. ``id`` null = a new one; omitted fields keep the stored value.

AllocationIn.title: AllocationIn
AllocationIn.description: An employee allocation: hours per week of one person given to one project for a period.

ApiTokenCreateIn.title: ApiTokenCreateIn
ApiTokenCreateIn.description: Create an API token for the signed-in user (the secret is in the response, once).

token.title: Token
token.description: the secret, shown only in this response

ApiTokenOut.title: ApiTokenOut
ApiTokenOut.description: A token as listed: never the secret and never the hash.

next.title: Next
next.description: `before` value for the next page, null at the end

next_id.title: Next Id
next_id.description: `before_id` value for the next page (with `next`), null at the end

CalendarIn.title: CalendarIn
CalendarIn.description: Connect a calendar: an https ICS link (``url``) or a file uploaded alongside these fields.

CommitmentChange.title: CommitmentChange
CommitmentChange.description: Overrides the period or hours of an existing contract or open offer. Omitted fields keep their value.

DocumentResult.title: DocumentResult
DocumentResult.description: A saved offer or invoice plus its non-blocking planning warnings (never stored).

recovery_codes.title: Recovery Codes
recovery_codes.description: shown exactly once; only hashes are stored

ExpenseLine.title: ExpenseLine
ExpenseLine.description: One line of an itemised bill (docs/specs/itemised-expenses.md). net/vat are derived by the server.

ExpenseLineIn.title: ExpenseLineIn
ExpenseLineIn.description: One line of an itemised bill. ``net`` and ``vat`` sent by a client are ignored (derived by the server).

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest
ExportRequest.description: Options of POST /api/data/export (docs/contracts/data-export.md). Unknown fields are refused.

LoginResult.title: LoginResult
LoginResult.description:
Either a session (`token` + `user`) or, for accounts with two-factor authentication, a challenge
(`mfa_required` + `mfa_token`) that POST /auth/login/totp turns into a session.

url.title: Url
url.description: Address of the company website or its Impressum page

password.title: Password
password.description: the boss's own password, as confirmation

SettingsIn.title: SettingsIn
SettingsIn.description: PUT /settings: any subset of the settings, each value checked.

SettingsResult.title: SettingsResult
SettingsResult.description: Saved settings plus advisory warnings about the tax ids and bank data (never stored).

SupplierLimited.title: SupplierLimited
SupplierLimited.description: The employee's view of a supplier.

TeamTimelineVisibilityIn.title: TeamTimelineVisibilityIn
TeamTimelineVisibilityIn.description:
``team_timeline_visibility`` of PUT /settings: the level per role. Only ``employee`` and ``accountant`` (the
boss is always ``full``); any other key, the boss included, is rejected. A missing key keeps its value.

TimelineAbsence.title: TimelineAbsence
TimelineAbsence.description: One stored absence as the viewer may see it (``kind`` and ``label`` are null where the level hides them).

TimerStartIn.title: TimerStartIn
TimerStartIn.description: Start the running timer of the current user (replaces a running one).

TimerStopIn.title: TimerStopIn
TimerStopIn.description: Stop the running timer and save it as a time entry; the note is optional.

qr_svg.title: Qr Svg
qr_svg.description: QR code as an SVG data URI

TripBills.title: TripBills
TripBills.description: The linked bills (expenses with this trip_id): count and sums of their net and VAT.

TripDay.title: TripDay
TripDay.description: One calendar day of the trip (stored with the trip, returned by preview and the trip).

TripFigures.title: TripFigures
TripFigures.description: Computed figures; the same numbers the trip stores, preview returns them without saving.

TripIn.title: TripIn
TripIn.description: A business trip. Figures (allowance, mileage, days) are computed by the server, never taken from the client.

TripItem.title: TripItem
TripItem.description: A planned expense of the trip (docs/specs/business-trips-wizard.md, section 4); ``expected`` is planning only.

TripLeg.title: TripLeg
TripLeg.description: One leg of the itinerary (docs/specs/business-trips-wizard.md, section 3).

TripPlace.title: TripPlace
TripPlace.description: The destination from a given day on (the first entry is the outbound destination).

role.title: Role
role.description: "member" is the old name of "employee" and is still accepted

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: read/write scope per area, derived from the role (never stored)

auth.description: how this request was authenticated (GET /auth/me only): a session or an API token

ApiToken.description: API token (`Authorization: Bearer pat_...`), created in the settings. It has the rights of its owner, optionally read-only, and can never use the session-only routes.
